_about: Public-domain Auguste Gratry (1805-1872, Oratorian, of the French Academy) in English for the Word Hoard: The Month of Mary (Baltimore, 1861), Henri Perreyve (London: Rivingtons, 1872) and the Guide to the Knowledge of God, tr. Abby Langdon Alger (Boston, 1892), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
